tools.name: track_package
tools.description: Gets one package's current status, courier, dates and event history from its tracking code, as spokepackagetracker.com shows them, with a link to that page. Without carrierId, it identifies the courier first: one match is tracked, several are returned as candidates without tracking, and none tries e

tools.name: identify_courier
tools.description: Identifies which couriers may have issued a package tracking code, from the code's format and a courier database. Returns each matching courier's ID and name, or an empty list when none matches. Does not look up the package's status.
